battery: Unqualified review candidate: Amazon Tenergy B077Y9HNTF / 11606, 12V 2Ah. Battery-only Amazon exception; other purchases need DigiKey/Mouser or course stock. Published 2A continuous limit and no established 10A pulse rating; final pack/charger selection open. Tenergy11609/01025 are zero-quantity references. See Parts-review.md.

servo_published_input.condition_limit: Current test voltage, temperature, tolerance, and static holding versus unloaded motion are not specified. Not a calibrated6.6V holding-current measurement.

average_planning_case.status: Calculated preliminary scenario, not measured, not a verified conservative bound for all driving
average_planning_case.motor_basis: Two catalog rated0.36A values treated as supply current under the stated nominal12V planning case; PWM/load dependence unvalidated.
average_planning_case.servo_basis: Published no-load and upper stall endpoint mixed with an assumed90/10 profile; no sustained-stall operating permission.
average_planning_case.runtime: Unverified; do not infer usable capacity or runtime guarantee from nominalAh.

servo_sense_checks.status: Ideal arithmetic only; ADC/reference, amplifier offset, noise, shunt tolerance and calibration remain unvalidated.

encoder_supply_revision.budget: Included within provisional 0.8A logic allocation; not a measured or guaranteed maximum
encoder_supply_revision.validation: Nominal 3.3V matches earlier lab supply; actual tolerance and signals untested

estimate_sensitivity.status: Calculated scenarios, not measured or guaranteed load/efficiency bounds; not an operating instruction
estimate_sensitivity.assumptions: Hold motor supply proxies at 0.72A planning and 6.4A stress; actual motor current depends on voltage/PWM/load. 80% and 85% efficiencies assumed. 8V is not an approved NiMH cutoff. Stress case exceeds L298 limits.
